lowelleast08: In Rosenau, Isidor Lowelleast was a stonemason. In R-F11, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a stonemason again.
Isidor Lowelleast received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
The patrol returned one at a time. Isidor Lowelleast held the entrance clear and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Drowned Farm. Isidor Lowelleast fired; Clement "Lucky" Johnrant pulled the bucket down. A sign later appeared: 'Water costs enough already.' From Verdel Ridge the Concord guns have a clear view. Isidor Lowelleast wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A shell burst in the trench at R-F11. Isidor Lowelleast was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run.
Isidor Lowelleast lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
shadowizard__: Leopold Shadowizard introduced himself as a schoolteacher from Dunmarrow. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Concord won Verdel Ridge. In R-F8, Leopold Shadowizard listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Leopold Shadowizard approved the method. The transfer made Leopold Shadowizard a sniper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Otto Elitecelebs kept watch so that Leopold Shadowizard could sleep. Then Leopold kept watch so that Otto could. Neither slept. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Shadowizard. Leopold Shadowizard read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
